title: Project MD
overview: "MD" (Molchat Doma) lives by a simple rule: transport the money, take the cut, and never get involved in anything that costs lives. But when a routine delivery goes horribly wrong, MD and his closest friend Naag find themselves trapped in a dangerous web of crime, betrayal, and hidden agendas. Forced to work for a powerful underworld figure "Raghu Pratap" while uncovering secrets connected to the mysterious death, the two are pulled deeper into a world far bigger than they ever imagined. As loyalties are tested and the line between friend and enemy begins to blur, MD must decide how far he's willing to go and whether he can survive the game.
